objetivos._comentario: Del P&L del cliente (brain/economia.md). El equilibrio es el numero duro; el objetivo es la meta de Juan.

activas.titulo: Meta · Prospecting | Advantage+: ROAS up 38% in 14 days
activas.detalle: 4.9x vs. 3.6x in the previous 14 days, while spend grew 22%. Frequency is steady at 1.8, so the audience is not saturated.
activas.accion: AI recommendation: raise the daily budget 20% every 3 days while 7-day ROAS stays above 4x. Projected +$6,800 revenue this month.

activas.titulo: Google · PMax | Seasonal: cost per purchase up 64%
activas.detalle: $38.20 over the last 3 days vs. $23.30 7-day average. 31% of spend went to search terms with "free" and "cheap".
activas.accion: AI recommendation: add the 14 flagged search terms as negatives (list ready for approval) and restore the previous ROAS target.

activas.titulo: Google · Search | Non-brand: conversion rate up 27% since the new landing page
activas.detalle: 4.1% vs. 3.2% before November 10, but the campaign loses 41% of impressions to budget.
activas.accion: AI recommendation: move $150/day from Shopping | Catch-all (2.1x) to this campaign. Projected +18 orders per week.

activas.titulo: Meta claims 2.3x the purchases Shopify shows for its UTMs
activas.detalle: 86 purchases reported vs. 37 Shopify orders with Meta UTMs in the last 7 days.
activas.accion: Check for duplicate Purchase events (Pixel and Conversions API without a shared event_id) before changing budgets.

activas.titulo: Returning-customer revenue up 19% month over month
activas.detalle: $41,200 vs. $34,600. Email and SMS flows drove 62% of it, and average order value is up 8%.
activas.accion: AI recommendation: build a lookalike audience from the top 10% of repeat buyers and test it in Meta prospecting.

activas.titulo: 6 top-selling products can't serve on Google while in stock
activas.detalle: Disapproved in Merchant Center for missing GTINs. They drove $9,800 in revenue last month.
activas.accion: Add the GTINs to the feed (list ready) and request a re-review. Revenue at risk: about $320 per day.

activas.titulo: TikTok · creator video #3 is the best ad this week
activas.detalle: 2-second retention 38%, CPC $0.41 and 5.8x ROAS on $640 of spend.
activas.accion: AI recommendation: brief 3 more creators with the same hook and pause the 4 static ads under 10% retention.

activas.titulo: Google will close the month 12% under budget
activas.detalle: At the last 3 days' pace Google spends $15,300 of the $17,400 budget.
activas.accion: Reallocate the gap to the two campaigns limited by budget, both above 5x ROAS.
